Maria Lopez.description: Maria Lopez has finished the consultation and is wrapping up the visit
chat: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. How old is the infant in days, and exactly when did you first notice the bilious vomiting and the inability to pass meconium? Also, have you observed any feeding difficulties or signs of dehydration since birth?

My little one is just two days old, and he started vomiting green fluid and hasn't passed any meconium since he was born at home. He is also very fussy and his belly looks swollen, which makes me worry he is in pain. We have had trouble getting him to keep milk down, and he seems quite lethargic.
